reviews.t: The best pain au chocolat I’ve ever tasted.

This bakery is absolutely delightful. They make the best pain au chocolate (chocolate croissant) that I’ve ever had in my life! It’s so buttery, flakey, and just melts in your mouth! The bread is baked fresh, so fresh, that the scent of fresh bread carries down the street. This is an Artisan Bakery, so the standard is much higher than your average bakery. My husband and I stayed in Paris for 7 days for our honeymoon, and we consistently came back to this bakery for breakfast and lunch. Their pastries are amazing as well; the chocolate éclair was out of this world! I cannot recommend this place enough!! I will be dreaming about the pastries here until we visit Paris again 💖✨

Vraiment une boulangerie au top 👌 Les viennoiseries sont délicieuses, bien beurrées et feuilletées 😍 Leur galette des rois a également fait le bonheur de beaucoup de monde, elle était incroyable ❤️
Enfin, on est très bien accueilli et servi rapidement.
Je ne peux que recommander !!
